authority: types/database.ts (generated Supabase types) is the runtime source of truth for Postgres.
notes: This file summarizes the shared cloud contract and documents PLANNED mobile SQLite shapes.
Do not merge cloud and mobile DDL into one logical table definition.
Removed legacy entries (e.g. accounts) that do not exist in types/database.ts.
Known drift: older markdown snapshots may omit columns; always prefer types/database.ts.

leads.purpose: Captured leads; shared by Lead Intel Scan (mobile) and Admin web.
columns_authoritative: enriched_* (job_title, company_size, industry, company_domain, linkedin_url, seniority, score)

campaign_messages.important: Uses recipient_id → campaign_recipients.id (not lead_id on this row).

signals.purpose: Signal Library definitions for campaign composition.

principles: SQLite is canonical for capture until sync succeeds.
Outbox records mutations; sync engine retries with backoff; server handlers should be idempotent where practical.
Supabase remains system of record after sync.
Audio: local file + outbox upload job — not blocking lead row creation.

local_leads.purpose: On-device lead capture payload and sync state (mirrors cloud fields as needed + local metadata).
local_leads.notes: Exact column set to be finalized in mobile implementation; must map cleanly to public.leads insert/update.

sync_outbox.purpose: Durable queue of operations to apply against Supabase.

engineering_alignment: Single source of truth for cloud: types/database.ts + migrations.
Deterministic sync ordering from outbox; safe retries; low-breakage API contracts.
Separate documentation for cloud vs local schema to avoid contradiction.
